changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.18

- Swaps now wait for the inventory to actually finish opening before navigating, instead of using a fixed delay. This fixes swaps that failed or desynced on slower machines where the menu had not fully opened yet.
- The "is the menu open" detection is resolution-independent and reads the fixed grey command bar at the bottom of the screen, so it works for every player regardless of emblem color or screen resolution.
- Swap profile: after the inventory opens it now waits 100ms, presses the loadouts key 5 times (10ms apart), then runs the click sequence.
- No changes to packet logic, keybinds, or the update process.
